desc:
Eat a huge waffle... that's literally it!

🧇 Hang out and munch on the delicious waffle with your friends. A sort of waffle eating simulator!
😋Every time you finish eating, a freshly baked waffle falls from the sky!
🎲Compete in random minigames
🤯Spawn crazy world events (NUKE and more) 💣
